tips.text: Bank Aya before the window opens; neither it nor the relics you hold expire.
Buy extra Barrel and Stock relics; every one carries it as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab in the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Run a Radiant radshare for the Rares.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Common relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
